DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 説明はここまでになります。後で確認したい場合のご案内も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: That concludes the explanation. Would you also like information on how to check anything later?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。今日の説明が分かりやすかったので、あなたの携帯へ次の質問を送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明した職員の個人携帯へ後日の質問を送りたいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, please. Your explanation today was easy to understand, so I would like to send my next question to your mobile phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you would like to send later questions to the personal mobile phone of the staff member who explained things.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 私個人の連絡先ではなく、この窓口への問い合わせ方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will explain how to contact this service counter, rather than give you my personal contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。同じ方に直接聞こうとしていましたが、個人的に連絡してよいわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ職員への私的連絡ではなく窓口問い合わせと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. I was trying to ask the same person directly, but that does not mean I may contact you privately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand inquiries should go to the service counter, rather than privately to the same staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お問い合わせには、今日確認した用件と、分からない点をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: When you contact us, please explain the matter we checked today and the points you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の用件をメモしておきます。「今日の人に聞きたい」だけでは、ほかの担当者に説明できませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他担当にも伝わる用件と不明点を自分で記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will make a note of my own situation. Just saying I want to ask the person from today would not explain it to another staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will record your situation and questions yourself so another staff member can understand them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。案内した窓口と、必要な場合の受付方法もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please also keep the information about the counter we directed you to and, if necessary, how to register an inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内紙を受け取ります。閉庁後に返事をもらえると思って私的な連絡先を探すのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内紙を受け取り閉庁後の私的応答を期待しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take the information sheet. I will stop looking for private contact details in the hope of getting an answer after the office closes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will take the information sheet and will not expect private replies after office hours.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 回答の方法や時間は、問い合わせ先でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the method and timing of replies with the office you contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内された窓口へ、自分の用件と質問をまとめて問い合わせます。本日の説明をありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 公式窓口へ質問をまとめて連絡すると決め感謝する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will organize my situation and questions and contact the counter you directed me to. Thank you for explaining everything today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have decided to organize your questions and contact the official counter, and express your thanks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you as well. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 画面の横の機器には触れず、こちらへご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please do not touch the equipment beside the screen. Ask us here instead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の番号が表示されているのが気になります。自分で消すボタンがあると思って探していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の番号表示を消すため機器のボタンを探したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am concerned that my number is displayed. I thought there might be a button to remove it myself, so I was looking for one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you were looking for a button on the equipment to remove your displayed number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の機器は職員が扱います。気になる点をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The display equipment is operated by staff. Please tell me what concerns you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ほかの人に、私が何の診察を受けるか分かるのではないかと心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号から診察内容が周囲へ伝わることを心配していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am worried that other people might be able to tell what kind of medical consultation I am having.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are worried people around you could learn what your medical consultation is about from the number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この画面に出ているのは順番の番号だけです。診療内容は表示していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: This screen only shows queue numbers. It does not display details of medical care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号と診療内容は同じではないのですね。それでも表示が気になる場合は、担当者へ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号だけの表示と理解しても担当へ希望を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the number and the details of my care are not the same thing. Even so, if the display still concerns me, I would like to discuss my wishes with the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand only the number is displayed but would still like to discuss your wishes with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望を担当に伝えます。表示を変更できるかは、その場での確認になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass your request on. Whether the display can be changed will have to be checked here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 変更が決まったとは考えず、相談を待ちます。機器を操作して順番を変えようとはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示変更は未決定として待ち自分で機器を操作しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait to discuss it without assuming a change has been decided. I will not operate the equipment to try to change the order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait, understanding no display change has been decided, and will not operate the equipment yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へおつなぎしますので、ご自身の番号をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will put you in touch with the person in charge, so please bring your number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号を持って相談します。表示を見た人が私の診療内容まで知っていると決めつけないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号を持って相談し他客が診療内容を知ると断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will bring my number and discuss it. I will avoid assuming that people who see the display also know the details of my care.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will bring your number to discuss your request and will not assume other visitors know the details of your care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望をお伝えします。それでは、こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass on your request. Please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の前に、携帯の通話について確認してよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before we discuss your situation, may I check about your phone call?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に状況を見てもらっています。私が説明するところも、このまま動画で伝えようと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人へ受付での説明を動画通話で見せようとしていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am showing a friend what is happening. I thought I would keep the video on to show them my explanation too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are trying to show a friend your explanation at reception through a video call.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 周囲の方や受付でのやり取りも映る可能性があります。まず通話を終えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Other people and exchanges at reception could also be recorded on the screen. Could you end the call first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の相談だけを見せるつもりでしたが、後ろの人も画面に入っていました。通話を切ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 他相談者も映ったと気づき通話を終了する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only meant to show my own consultation, but the people behind me were in the picture too. I will end the call.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you realized other people seeking advice were also on screen and will end the call.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。通話が終わってから、ご用件を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you. I will hear what you need once the call has ended.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 終えました。友人は説明を一緒に考えてくれていた人で、相談する本人は私です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通話終了と友人が助言者で相談本人は自分だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have ended it. My friend was helping me think through the explanation; I am the person seeking advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the call has ended, your friend is an adviser, and you are the person seeking advice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の言葉で、確認していることからお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain in your own words, starting with what you have confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人の反応を見ながら説明を変えるのでなく、自分が困っていることを順に話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人の反応で変えず本人の事情を順に話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will explain my difficulties in order, rather than change my explanation according to my friend's reactions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will explain your own circumstances in order without changing them according to your friend's reactions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談後に友人へ伝える内容も、ご自身で整理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also organize for yourself what to tell your friend after the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 他の人や職員の姿をそのまま送らず、私の用件と案内されたことを、後で自分の言葉でまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談後は他人の映像を送らず本人の言葉で内容をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Instead of sending images of other people or staff as they are, I will later summarize my situation and the guidance I received in my own words.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that after the consultation you will summarize the information in your own words without sending images of other people.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、担当へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. I will now direct you to the person in charge. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒に貼ってあるこちらの紙について、確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please let me check this piece of paper attached to your envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が作った飾りです。切手のような形で数字もあるので、この数字の分は料金を払ったつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切手風の自作飾りの数字を郵便料金支払済みと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a decoration my friend made. It is shaped like a stamp and has a number on it, so I thought I had paid that amount in postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you thought the number on a homemade stamp-like decoration meant the postage had been paid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙飾りと、郵便料金の支払いは別に確認します。飾りに印刷した数字だけでは支払い済みとは扱いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We check the paper decoration and payment of postage separately. A number printed on a decoration alone does not count as proof of payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 飾りの数字を足して金額を計算していました。実際に料金を支払った記録ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 印刷数字は本人の料金支払記録でないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was adding the numbers on the decorations to calculate the amount. So they are not a record of postage actually paid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you understand the printed numbers are not a record of your postage payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。発送する現物を確認して、必要な手続きをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is right. We will check the actual item you are sending and explain the necessary procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この封筒を見てください。飾りは友人の作品ですが、料金不足をなくすための手続きを先にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作品を示し発送現物の手続きと料金確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please look at this envelope. The decoration is my friend's artwork, but first I would like to complete the procedure to avoid insufficient postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the artwork and say in Japanese that you would like the procedure and postage checked for the actual item you are sending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 飾りをそのまま使えるかも、現物で確認します。いま外したり付け加えたりせず、お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also check the actual item to see whether the decoration can stay. Please wait without removing or adding anything yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 待ちます。切手に似ているからと、自分で別の数字を書き足すことはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飾り確認を待ち数字を自分で追加しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait. I will not write additional numbers on it myself just because it looks like a stamp.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait for the decoration to be checked and will not add numbers yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの飾りは外してからお出しください。外した後の封筒で料金を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please remove this decoration before posting the envelope. We will check the postage using the envelope after it has been removed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、飾りは作品として家に残します。送る封筒から外し、必要な料金の案内を受けてから差し出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飾りを外す案内を受け作品を保管し郵便料金の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will keep the decoration at home as artwork. I will remove it from the envelope and post it after receiving guidance on the required postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that, following the instruction to remove the decoration, you will keep it as artwork and ask for the postage to be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご準備後に受付へお持ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring it to the counter once it is ready. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご自身で作った家計のメモをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you brought the household budget notes you made yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。食費と交通費を書き、その下の小計も全部足しました。この大きな金額だけ毎月必要だと考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 個別支出と小計を全部足して月必要額と考えたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wrote down food and transport expenses and added all the subtotals below them too. I think I need that large amount every month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you added both individual expenses and all the subtotals and thought the result was the amount needed each month.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この小計には、上の食費と交通費が含まれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does this subtotal include the food and transport expenses above it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 含まれています。同じ出費を個別の欄と小計の欄で二度足したかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小計に個別費が含まれ二重計上かもしれないと気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It does. I may have added the same expenses twice, in the individual entries and in the subtotal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have realized the subtotal includes the individual expenses and you may have counted them twice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身の表の計算を確かめてから、相談の数字を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the calculations in your own table before organizing the figures for the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この金額を銀行で確かめた額として使うのはやめます。まず、何を足したか見直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 銀行確認額と扱わず本人表の足した項目を見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will stop using this figure as an amount confirmed by the bank. First, I would like to review what I added together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not treat the figure as bank-confirmed and will review the items you added in your own table.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 個別の記録は消さず、小計と合計の欄を分けて見直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can review it by separating the subtotal and total columns without erasing the individual records.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 食費と交通費の記録は残し、小計をもう一度足した部分に印を付けます。出費そのものが減ったわけではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 個別記録を保ち重複に印を付け実際の支出減少と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will keep the food and transport records and mark the part where I added the subtotal again. That does not mean my actual expenses have gone down.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the individual records, mark the duplication, and distinguish it from an actual reduction in spending.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。記録した出費と、計算の重なりを分けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. Please check the recorded expenses separately from the duplication in the calculation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 計算を整理してから相談を続けたいです。二重計上を直した差を、実際に節約したお金とは数えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 修正差額を節約金と扱わず計算整理後に相談を続ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like to continue the consultation after organizing the calculation. I will not count the difference from correcting the double counting as money I actually saved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not treat the corrected difference as savings and will continue the consultation after organizing the calculation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表を整理された後、相談担当へお声がけください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please speak to the consultation staff after organizing your table. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 大袋のお菓子をいくつかお求めですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking to buy several large bags of snacks?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一袋を職場で分けたいです。外の袋はかさばるので、帰ったら捨てて、中身だけ小さい容器に入れるつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大袋の外装を捨て中身だけ職場で配る予定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to share one bag at work. The outer bag is bulky, so I plan to throw it away when I get home and put just the contents in a small container.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you plan to throw away the large outer bag and distribute only the contents at work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食品の表示は外の袋にあります。分けるときも、表示を確認できるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The food information is on the outer bag. Please make sure it can still be checked when you share the snacks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい一つ一つには、同じ説明が全部付いていないのですね。外の袋を捨てる前に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 個包装に表示が揃うとは限らず外装廃棄前に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So each small packet does not have all the same information on it. I will check before throwing away the outer bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that individual packets may not contain all the information and you will check before discarding the outer packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの表示がどこにあるかは、現物でご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the actual product to see which information is printed where.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この袋では材料と保存の案内が外側にあります。自分だけ読めば十分とは考えず、食べる人にも見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 材料と保存案内を本人だけでなく受取人にも見せたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: On this bag, the ingredients and storage instructions are on the outside. I do not think it is enough for only me to read them; I want the people eating the snacks to see them too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you would like recipients, as well as yourself, to see the ingredients and storage instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分け方は、受け取る方が情報を確認できる方法をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please choose a way of sharing that allows recipients to check the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 職場では元の袋も一緒に置きます。袋を残せない場所へ分けるなら、別の商品も考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原袋を一緒に置き不可なら商品選択も見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will leave the original bag alongside the snacks at work. If I share them somewhere I cannot leave the bag, I will consider a different product too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will leave the original bag with the snacks and reconsider the product if that is not possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入される物は決まりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you decided what to buy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は元の袋ごと置ける分だけ買います。中身を配った後に表示がなくて困る状態を避けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原袋ごと置ける分だけ購入して配布後の情報欠落を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will only buy as much as I can leave with the original bag. I will avoid a situation where people have no information after I hand out the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will only buy what can be left in the original bag, avoiding missing information after distribution.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの一袋で承ります。それでは、レジへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: One bag of these, then. Please come to the checkout. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの空いている所を、ほかの方も使えるようにしていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you leave this empty space available for other people to use too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が三人来るので、空いている所にかばんを置き始めました。全員の席を取っておくつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仲間分の空席を荷物で確保し始めたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Three friends are coming, so I started putting bags in the empty places. I meant to save seats for everyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you started reserving empty seats for your friends with luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いま、お連れの方は近くにいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are your companions nearby at the moment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ来ていません。ここにいるのは私だけです。来る人数だけを考えて、座る方の場所をふさいでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在いるのは本人一人で残りは未到着だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: They have not arrived yet. I am the only one here. I was only thinking about how many people were coming and blocking space for people who want to sit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are currently the only one here and the others have not arrived.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ベンチは皆さんでお使いいただく場所です。まだ来ていない方の席を、荷物で取っておかないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The bench is shared by everyone. Please do not reserve seats with luggage for people who have not arrived yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: かばんを膝へ移します。友人が来る予定でも、私が空いた所をずっと使えるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 共用ベンチの案内を受け荷物を膝へ移して空席を空ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will move my bag onto my lap. Even though my friends are coming, I will not assume I can keep using all the empty space.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will follow the guidance about the shared bench, move your luggage to your lap, and free the empty seats.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。待合せを続けることはできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. You are welcome to keep waiting for them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人には私がこのベンチにいるとだけ連絡します。三人分の席が確保できたとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在地だけ仲間へ伝え空席保証をせず合流後に休憩を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will just tell my friends I am on this bench. I will not say I have secured three seats for them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will only tell your friends your location, make no guarantee of seats, and decide where to rest after meeting up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 合流した後、皆さんで休む場所をお決めください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you have met up, please decide together where to rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今の空席はほかの方が使えるようにして待ちます。全員そろってから、無理に一つのベンチへ座ろうとせず相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ベンチの空きを他客が利用できるようにして待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will wait while leaving the current empty seats available to others. Once everyone is here, we will discuss it without trying to force everyone onto one bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait while making the empty bench space available to other visitors.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。それでは、待合せも公園も気持ちよくお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Enjoy meeting your friends and spending time in the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待合の通路に何か転がったようですが、お客様のお荷物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Something seems to have rolled into the waiting room aisle. Is it from your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、紙袋の底が破れて、果物が出てしまいました。一個は向こうへ転がり、今は見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋が破れ果物が出て一個の現在位置は見えないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, the bottom of my paper bag tore and some fruit fell out. One piece rolled away, and I cannot see it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that the bag tore, fruit fell out, and you cannot see where one piece is now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見えない物を追う前に、こちらで状況を伺います。ほかにも荷物がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Before you chase something you cannot see, let me check the situation here. Do you have any other bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 足元に別の袋があります。そちらまで倒さないように、いったん椅子の前でまとめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別の荷物も倒さないようその場でまとめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is another bag at my feet. I would like to gather everything in front of the chair for now so I do not knock that one over too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you would like to gather your belongings where you are so the other bag does not fall over too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その位置でお願いします。転がった方向は、指で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do that where you are. Can you point in the direction it rolled?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あちらの通路へ向かいました。曲がり角の先は見ていないので、その先にあるとは言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目撃した転がる方向と曲がり角の先の未確認を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It went toward that aisle. I did not see beyond the corner, so I cannot say for certain that it is past there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese between the direction you saw it roll and the unchecked area beyond the corner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 職員が確認します。見えている果物も、お客様が通路へ急に出て拾わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: A staff member will check. Please do not suddenly step into the aisle to pick up even the fruit you can see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。破れた袋には戻さず、残りをかばんの中の袋へ移して待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路へ追わず破袋でない入れ物へ残りを移して待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not put the remaining fruit back in the torn bag. I will transfer it to a bag inside my backpack and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait without following it into the aisle and transfer the remaining fruit into a container other than the torn bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認ができました。拾った物はこちらでお渡ししますので、数をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have checked. We will hand you the items we picked up here, so please check how many there are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取った数を確かめます。買った数を覚えていないので、全部戻ったとはまだ言わず、かばんも見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回収品の数を確認し全数回収を未確認のまま断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the number I receive. I do not remember how many I bought, so I will not say everything has been returned yet; I will check my bag too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will count the recovered items and will not state they have all been recovered while that remains unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認をお願いします。それでは、足元にお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check them. Watch your step.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この文章では、申請を取りやめたいというご希望に見えます。間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This text seems to say that you want to withdraw your application. Is that correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 取りやめたいわけではありません。自分で自動翻訳した文なので、質問の意味が変わったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自動翻訳の取消表現は本人の希望でないと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not want to withdraw it. I translated the text automatically myself, so the meaning of my question may have changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the misunderstanding in Japanese: the cancellation wording in the automatic translation does not express your wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いま確認したいことを、短くご自身の言葉でお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please briefly tell me in your own words what you want to check now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どこへ書類を出すか知りたいです。申請する予定は変えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先が質問で申請予定は変わらないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to know where to submit the documents. My plan to apply has not changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your question concerns where to submit the documents and your plan to apply has not changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出先を尋ねたいということですね。文章の取りやめの部分は、ご希望ではないと確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you want to ask where to submit them. I will confirm that the withdrawal part of the text does not express your wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、その部分で手続きを進めないでください。言葉をきれいに訳せたと思って、内容まで正しいと考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 翻訳の誤表現で取消処理を進めないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, please do not proceed on the basis of that part. Because I thought the wording had translated neatly, I assumed the content was correct too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese that cancellation not be processed based on the mistranslated wording.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 自動翻訳の文章だけでは判断せず、ご希望を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check your wishes and guide you without relying only on the automatically translated text.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 質問を一つずつ言います。提出先の次に、まだ書けていない欄を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提出先と未記入欄を一つずつ質問すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask one question at a time. After asking where to submit the documents, I would like advice on the fields I have not filled in yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have decided to ask about the submission destination and uncompleted fields one at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず提出先について担当へおつなぎします。ご不明の欄もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: First, I will refer you to the person in charge of where to submit the documents. Please also bring the fields you are unsure about.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書類を持って相談します。取りやめの依頼ではなく、出し方の確認だと最初に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書類を持ち取消でなく提出方法の確認と担当へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will bring the documents to discuss them. I will start by saying I want to check how to submit them, not request cancellation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will bring the documents and tell the person in charge you are checking the submission procedure, not requesting cancellation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を確認できました。それでは、担当の窓口へどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed your wishes. Please go to the relevant counter. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先ほど、昨日より楽になったとおっしゃいましたね。今は痛みがないというご説明でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Earlier you said you felt better than yesterday. Do you mean you have no pain now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 痛みがないという意味ではありません。昨日と比べた話で、今も気になるので相談に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日との比較で今の痛み消失を意味しないと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not mean I have no pain. I was comparing it with yesterday, and I came for advice because it still bothers me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct the misunderstanding in Japanese: a comparison with yesterday does not mean your current pain has disappeared.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の状態を、担当へ伝わるようにお話しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please explain your current condition so the person in charge can understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 座っている間は昨日より楽です。でも、歩いて来る途中には痛みがありました。全部の場面で同じではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 座位の変化と来院歩行中の痛みを別々に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: While sitting, I feel better than yesterday. But I had pain while walking here. It is not the same in every situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese, separately, the change while sitting and the pain while walking to the clinic.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いを担当へお伝えください。受付では状態の判断はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the person in charge about that difference. We do not assess your condition at reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日よりまし、だけで終えず、座っている時と歩いた時を分けて説明します。受診の相談も取りやめません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 比較語だけで済ませず状況別に話し受診相談を続ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not stop at saying it is better than yesterday; I will explain sitting and walking separately. I will not cancel my request for advice about seeing a doctor either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will explain each situation instead of using only a comparison, and continue seeking advice about a medical consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いまお話しになったことを、メモでお持ちいただくこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also bring a note of what you have just explained.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日との比較と、今日の歩行中のことを別に書きます。痛みなしと短くまとめないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 過去比較と本日の出来事を別欄にし痛みなしと要約しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write the comparison with yesterday and what happened while walking today separately. I will avoid shortening it to no pain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will put the past comparison and today's events in separate sections without summarizing them as no pain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご案内がありましたら、そのメモを担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you are called, please show the note to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモを見せて、今も相談したい状態だと伝えます。改善した部分を話すことと、全部問題ないと決めることを分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メモで現在の相談希望を示し部分改善と全体問題なしを分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the note and say I still want advice about my condition. I will distinguish talking about the parts that improved from deciding everything is fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will use the note to convey your current wish for advice, distinguishing partial improvement from an overall absence of problems.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 座っている時と歩いた時の違いも、担当へお伝えください。それでは、診察のご案内をお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-19207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please also tell the person in charge about the difference between sitting and walking. Now please wait to be called for your medical consultation. Excuse me.
